answer_1.quote: We evaluate the accuracy(↑) of LLMs on downstream datasets to determine whether TaylorMLP can preserve the accuracy of original LLMs. Moreover, we measure the per-token latency to assess the generation speed . It is the time cost of generating a single token.
answer_1.outputs: The paper evaluates generated outputs in tasks such as question answering and dialogue generation, including token-level generation and chat capabilities.

answer_2.quote: we measure the Kullback-Leibler divergence(↓) and ROUGE-1 score(↑) of TaylorMLP's outputs, using the original LLM's outputs as the ground-truth values.
